name: TitleMetadataReadinessConsole
tagline: Know which titles are ready for which platform – and fix the gaps in one click.
description: A complete distribution metadata desk for Power Platform: every title and episode is checked against each platform's own spec – synopsis lengths, artwork, ratings and advisories, cast, EIDR, captions, trailer and the availability window. A titles × platforms readiness matrix, top-gap analysis, one-click trim and copy-from-other-platform fixes, a rule-checked delivery pipeline with platform rejections, and a deadline calendar keep every window on time.
features: Per-platform metadata spec engine (low-code Platform rules)
Readiness score and checklist per delivery
Top metadata gaps across the catalogue
Trim over-length synopses and copy metadata from other platforms
Rule-checked pipeline with QC, delivery, acceptance and rejection reasons
Deadline calendar: overdue, due soon, going live without delivery
Bulk send to QC, assign coordinator, fill gaps, export feed
Undo, demo mode with fictional data
